headlines.description: Paris Saint-Germain continued to put their early-season struggles behind them by beating Le Mans 3-1 to register a third successive Ligue 1 win.
headlines.shortLinkText: PSG stroll to third straight league win

headlines.description: Ousmane Dembele inspired a Paris St Germain comeback after coming off the bench to score and contribute an assist in their 3-1 victory at Strasbourg in Ligue 1.
headlines.shortLinkText: USMNT's Reyna scores as Strasbourg beaten by PSG

events.name: AJ Auxerre at Le Havre AC

headlines.description: Senny Mayulu and Mika Godts both came off the bench to score late goals as Paris Saint-Germain moved top of Ligue 1 with a 2-0 win over Lyon on Monday.
headlines.shortLinkText: PSG beat Lyon in rescheduled match to top Ligue 1

events.name: Paris Saint-Germain at Le Havre AC
